## What this site answers

- Buying a home in Islamabad or Lahore: prices by area (DHA, Bahria Town,
  Gulberg, F-7/F-8, E-11, B-17, Model Town, Lake City), title verification
  (fard, mutation/intiqal, no-demand certificate), token money and bayana,
  negotiation norms, transfer-day process.
- Selling a house fast: comparable-sales pricing, required paperwork,
  seller taxes, average three-week close record.
- Overseas Pakistanis: buying and selling on a registered power of attorney
  without traveling; embassy attestation; NICOP; safe banking channels.
- Investment: gross rental yields (typically 2–4% in prime Islamabad and
  Lahore), appreciation vs yield, emerging areas (B-17, Bahria Enclave,
  Lake City) vs established (DHA, F-7/F-8, Gulberg), filer vs non-filer tax
  impact.
- Costs: property transfer costs in Pakistan (typically 2–7% of declared
  value: FBR advance tax, stamp duty, society/CDA fees), DC rate vs FBR
  value vs market value.
- Free tools on the site: home-finance EMI calculator, rental yield & ROI
  calculator, PKR currency converter with live rates, instant valuation
  ranges by area and plot size, and a live price guide for Islamabad and
  Lahore.
